confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than July accommodation rates, which are the least certain. Figures are in USD at roughly 1.12 USD per EUR. July is outside the Canary Islands' winter peak, so hotel and hostel anchors sit at a summer shoulder level. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages, which were not opened directly; the 15 October overview figure (0.6955) differs from the 16 October table figure used here.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Las Palmas de Gran Canaria and mid-sized Spanish port and resort cities such as Málaga, adjusted for Santa Cruz's city-centre hotel and bar mix. No single source was used for the price points.
